title: /grade step 2 and the no-re-dispatch rule agree on unusable verdicts
item: grade.md step 2 says dispatch a judge for every listed task; its closing paragraph says never re-dispatch one whose verdict file exists. grade.py re-lists tasks with unusable verdicts, so both apply to the same task
motivation: Found by the task 36 reviewer: the two instructions conflict exactly for unusable verdicts.
done_means: grade.md says what to do with a listed task whose verdict file exists but is unusable, and step 2 and the closing paragraph do not contradict each other.
